name: Asian Steak & Mango Salad with Bell Pepper & Romaine
instructions: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Wash, dry, peel, and mince ginger.
Season steak generously with salt and pepper on both sides.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with foil.
Wash, dry, and juice lime into a small bowl. Add ginger, oil, honey, and soy sauce. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Wash and dry lettuce. Halve lengthwise, then chop crosswise into 1 inch strips. Transfer to a large bowl.

Wash and dry mangoes, bell peppers, and green onions. Peel, cut flesh away from the pit, julienne (cut into thin strips), and add mangoes to bowl with lettuce. Seed, julienne, and add peppers to bowl. Trim and discard root ends, chop green onions, and add to bowl.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, arrange salad on a plate and top with steak slices. Drizzle with dressing and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
